faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How often should I apply KLN Hair Growth Oil?
faq.a1: For optimal results, apply 2-3 times a week directly to the scalp. Gently massage for 10 minutes and leave on overnight or at least 2 hours before washing with a mild natural shampoo.
faq.q2: Is this product suitable for all hair types?
faq.a2: Yes! Our Kshirapaka formula is balanced for all scalp types, including dry, oily, color-treated, and sensitive scalps.
faq.q3: Does it contain mineral oil or artificial parabens?
faq.a3: No. All KLN Ayurveda products are 100% free from mineral oil, parabens, silicones, sulfates, and synthetic fragrances.
faq.a4: Standard express delivery takes 2-4 business days across metro cities and 3-6 business days for the rest of India.
